headline: Introduces the hand-drawn Papercraft theme with stop-motion folding and crumpling animations.

entries.title: Papercraft theme
entries.details: A new hand-drawn theme featuring soft torn paper, doodles, washi tape, and custom handwritten fonts. Opening the bag unfolds the paper sheet, while closing crumples it into a ball and tosses it away in a stop-motion style. You can toggle the folding and stop-motion effects individually under Appearance > Animation.
